p='submission/main.py'; s=open(p).read()

end = s.index('def canonical_dfa(')
new = '''def hopcroft_blocks(n, trans, accept, alpha):
    """Coarsest partition refinement (Hopcroft).

    Blocks are kept as contiguous ranges of the permuted array ``items`` so a
    split only touches the states that actually move, which keeps the whole
    refinement near O(states * symbols * log(states)).
    """
    non_list = [s for s in range(n) if not accept[s]]
    acc_list = [s for s in range(n) if accept[s]]
    items = non_list + acc_list
    pos = [0] * n
    for i, s in enumerate(items):
        pos[s] = i
    blocks = []
    if non_list:
        blocks.append([0, len(non_list)])
    if acc_list:
        blocks.append([len(non_list), n])
    block_of = [0] * n
    for b, rng in enumerate(blocks):
        for i in range(rng[0], rng[1]):
            block_of[items[i]] = b

    inv_off = []
    inv_flat = []
    for a in range(alpha):
        counts = [0] * n
        for s in range(n):
            counts[trans[s][a]] += 1
        off = [0] * (n + 1)
        running = 0
        for t in range(n):
            off[t] = running
            running += counts[t]
        off[n] = running
        flat = [0] * n
        fill = off[:n]
        for s in range(n):
            t = trans[s][a]
            flat[fill[t]] = s
            fill[t] += 1
        inv_off.append(off)
        inv_flat.append(flat)

    work = deque()
    in_work = [0] * len(blocks)
    smallest = min(range(len(blocks)), key=lambda b: blocks[b][1] - blocks[b][0])
    work.append(smallest)
    in_work[smallest] = 1

    while work:
        b = work.popleft()
        in_work[b] = 0
        for a in range(alpha):
            bstart, bend = blocks[b]
            off = inv_off[a]
            flat = inv_flat[a]
            groups = {}
            for i in range(bstart, bend):
                t = items[i]
                lo = off[t]
                hi = off[t + 1]
                if hi == lo:
                    continue
                for s in flat[lo:hi]:
                    bid = block_of[s]
                    got = groups.get(bid)
                    if got is None:
                        groups[bid] = [s]
                    else:
                        got.append(s)
            for cid, members in groups.items():
                cstart, cend = blocks[cid]
                csize = cend - cstart
                moved = len(members)
                if moved == csize:
                    continue
                i = cstart
                for s in members:
                    p = pos[s]
                    if p != i:
                        other = items[i]
                        items[i] = s
                        items[p] = other
                        pos[s] = i
                        pos[other] = p
                    i += 1
                nid = len(blocks)
                blocks.append([cstart, i])
                blocks[cid] = [i, cend]
                in_work.append(0)
                for s in members:
                    block_of[s] = nid
                rest = cend - i
                if in_work[cid]:
                    work.append(nid)
                    in_work[nid] = 1
                elif moved <= rest:
                    work.append(nid)
                    in_work[nid] = 1
                else:
                    work.append(cid)
                    in_work[cid] = 1

    return blocks, block_of, items
